summary: The PR adds precomputed CDFs for several distributions, addressing the issue of integration difficulties. However, there are some minor issues related to style and documentation.

issues.description: The new file `new_crv_types.py` contains a mix of distributions that were previously scattered across different files. This could make future maintenance harder as it breaks the existing organization.
Some of the new distributions lack detailed docstrings explaining their parameters and usage, which could confuse users.
